description: Apply the US Foreign Earned Income Exclusion physical-presence day-count method to travel entries, including the best rolling 12-month window. This is the tax-specific calculation, not the general by-country travel summary in count_travel_days. Each entry is arrival|departure|type, where type is us, other or transit; transit under 24 hours counts zero.
name: calculate_feie_days
title: Calculate FEIE physical-presence days
